# Culture Tourist

> > A cultural travel guide focused on European art, architecture, and heritage destinations, with deep coverage of Dutch Golden Age masters, museum experiences, and UNESCO cultural routes.

Culture Tourist provides in-depth guides to museums, historic sites, and cultural destinations across Europe, with particular expertise in Dutch art (Rembrandt, Van Gogh), Romanesque architecture routes (TRANSROMANICA, Rota do Romanico), and family-friendly cultural tourism. The site combines practical travel advice with art history education and museum visit strategies.

## Key Topics

- Dutch Golden Age
- Rembrandt van Rijn
- Vincent van Gogh
- Amsterdam museums
- Rijksmuseum
- TRANSROMANICA route
- Cultural tourism
- Museum visiting guides
- European heritage sites
- Art history education
- Family-friendly travel
- Romanesque architecture
- Belgian cultural destinations
- UNESCO World Heritage
- Art tourism
